name: Ninomiya Rin
source:
Underclassman. Part of a set of twins-- to tell them apart, Rin has long hair, and Ran has short hair.

Very mischievous and capricious. Friendly-seeming at first glance, but it's hard to tell what either of them are actually thinking. They're also Sayaka's maternal cousins.
